text: Percentage denominators: "row" (row %), "col" (column %), "cell" (total table %). Effect measures: "rr" (Relative Risk / Risk Ratio), "" (Odds Ratio), "pr" (Prevalence Ratio). Inference: "p" (adds p-value), "miss" (displays missing categories). design: Epidemiological study design ("cohort", "case_control", "cross_sectional"). specified without explicit measure flags, SimtablR automatically resolves correct effect measure (e.g., RR cohorts, case-control). strat: Stratifying variable. Calculates stratum-specific effects, tests homogeneity odds/risk ratios across strata, computes Greenland-Robins Mantel-Haenszel pooled estimates. ref: Overrides reference level exposure outcome categories without requiring relevel() data transformations. Multiple bivariate tables can also stacked single consolidated summary using standard rbind():
code: # Example 2.1: Exposure-stratified cohort 2x2 table with Risk Ratio tb(epitabl, renal_impairment, adjudicated_acs, flags = c("row", "rr"), design = "cohort")  # Example 2.2: Stratified analysis with Mantel-Haenszel pooling across sex tb(epitabl, renal_impairment, adjudicated_acs, strat = sex, flags = c("row", "or")) tab1 <- tb(epitabl, smoking, adjudicated_acs, flags = c("row", "or")) tab2 <- tb(epitabl, diabetes, adjudicated_acs, flags = c("row", "or")) rbind(tab1, tab2)

text: regtab() fits generalized linear models (GLMs) across one multiple outcomes shared predictor specification, reporting adjusted effect measures confidence intervals.
code: regtab(data, outcomes, predictors, family = binomial("logit"), robust = TRUE, method = "glm", ...)

previous_headings: Core Functions & Key Parameters > 3. Multivariable Regression & Rare-Event Modeling: regtab()
title: SimtablR: Design-Aware Epidemiological Tables
text: outcomes: Character vector outcome variables. Specifying multiple outcomes fits separate models simultaneously binds consolidated publication table. predictors: Two-sided formula (e.g., ~ age + sex + smoking + renal_impairment). family: Standard GLM error distribution link function (binomial("logit"), gaussian(), poisson(), quasipoisson()). robust: Robust sandwich covariance estimation. Defaults TRUE (HC0 heteroscedasticity-consistent variance). Supports "HC3" small samples, FALSE classical model-based variance. "glm" (default): Standard maximum likelihood. "firth": Firth’s penalized likelihood regression (via logistf), eliminating small-sample bias handling complete separation rare clinical exposures.
code: # Example 3.1: Multivariable logistic regression with HC0 robust standard errors fit_glm <- regtab(   epitabl,   outcomes = "adjudicated_acs",   predictors = ~ age + sex + smoking + hypertension + diabetes + renal_impairment,   family = binomial("logit"),   robust = TRUE ) fit_glm  # Example 3.2: Firth penalized likelihood for rare exposure (maintenance dialysis) fit_firth <- regtab(   epitabl,   outcomes = "adjudicated_acs",   predictors = ~ age + sex + dialysis,   family = binomial("logit"),   method = "firth" ) fit_firth
